features.name: main.py — process launcher
features.detail: UTF-8 reconfigures stdout. init_db(), seeds demo data on first empty run, starts the APScheduler background scheduler, runs the FastAPI API (8505) on a daemon thread, then serves the Gradio UI (7845) on the main thread. Logs to data/logs/akiyascout.log.

features.name: Start_AkiyaScout.bat
features.detail: Console launcher: cd C:\AkiyaScout && python main.py. No NSSM service registered yet (QI_AkiyaScout is planned).

features.name: Config loader
features.detail: App name/version, server ports (api 8505 / ui 7845 / host 127.0.0.1), logging level + dir. Runtime settings (rates, intervals, flags) live in the DB settings table, not here.

features.name: QI contract endpoints
features.detail: GET /health -> {status:ok}; /version -> project/version/status; /info reads qi_registry.json via QI.project('akiyascout'). CORS origins from qi_registry with localhost fallback. init_db() on startup.

features.name: Listings API
features.detail: GET /listings with type/q/pref/region/price_usd_max/price_jpy_max/akiya_bank/limit (le=2000); delegates to queries.search_listings. GET /listings/{id} returns one enriched row or 404.

features.name: Profiles CRUD + matches
features.detail: Full CRUD on /profiles with Pydantic ProfileIn/ProfilePatch (name, criteria dict, cadence, active). GET /profiles/{id}/matches returns scored matches.

features.name: Ingest + notifications + digest
features.detail: POST /ingest?sources=comma,list runs pipeline.ingest. GET /notifications(+unread_only), POST /notifications/{id}/read, POST /digest?profile_ids=1,2 build an on-demand digest.

features.name: Reference endpoints
features.detail: GET /stats (listing/profile/match counts), /regions (47 prefectures), /sources (7 sources ordered by type).

features.name: Ingest orchestrator
features.detail: For each enabled source adapter: fetch_raw -> _store_raw -> normalize -> _upsert_listing, accumulating stats {fetched,new,updated,duplicate,unchanged}. Stamps sources.last_run, then match_for_listings() over touched ids.

features.name: Raw immutable capture
features.detail: Stores the raw adapter dict + content_hash in raw_listings (UNIQUE source_id,source_listing_id) so listings can be re-parsed without re-scraping; updates only on hash change. 1,915 raw rows.

features.name: Upsert + cross-source dedup
features.detail: New vs updated vs duplicate vs unchanged. Same raw_id => update on hash change; otherwise a matching active dedup_key from ANY source collapses to duplicate. 32-column listing write.

features.name: On-demand profile pull
features.detail: Expands a profile's prefectures/regions to target codes, routes akiya-bank vs SUUMO sources by property type, sets live_target_prefectures override, ingests, geocodes, re-matches. refresh() wipes-then-pulls; clear_listings() resets listings/raw/matches/notifications.

features.name: Adapter base contract
features.detail: fetch_raw() returns live data when use_live_scraping=1 else loads JSON fixtures. Polite _get(): rate-limited (rate_limit_sec), courteous UA, follow_redirects, 20s timeout. fetch_live() raises NotImplementedError by default; one bad source never aborts ingest.

features.name: at-home Akiya Bank live scraper
features.detail: Crawls https://www.akiya-athome.jp/buy/<JIS>/ per in_poc prefecture (JIS-code map for all 47), selectolax parses section.propety cards for price/area/layout/type/photo. parse_detail() adds spec table + photos. 926 listings.

features.name: SUUMO live scraper
features.detail: Used detached houses (中古一戸建て). Pulls prefecture page + drills into up to 3 city result-pages (populous prefs gate behind a city picker), parses div.property_unit. Profile-driven target prefectures. 939 listings.

features.name: Fixture / placeholder portals
features.detail: LIFULL, at-home commercial, HOME'S, Rakumachi and Municipal-Nagano adapters document their live selectors but inherit fixture-only loading; fetch_live() not yet implemented. 7 adapters registered.

features.name: Normalizer
features.detail: Maps raw -> uniform listing fields; derives build_era (Showa/Heisei/Reiwa) and seismic class (1981 boundary), estimates renovation cost, infers bedrooms from LDK layout, and builds a SHA1 dedup_key bucketed by prefecture + 5sqm area + 100k-yen price + address head.

features.name: Translation engine (cached, fallback chain)
features.detail: JA->EN with persistent translations cache (SHA1 src_hash). auto order DeepL -> local Ollama -> offline glossary stub; first available wins. 187 cached, all via ollama. Empty input safe; reuses an open conn to avoid write-locks.

features.name: Lazy field translation
features.detail: Titles translated at ingest (or supplied by the adapter); descriptions translated lazily on listing open to keep bulk ingest fast; addresses/municipalities mirrored JA->EN verbatim (no slow romaji).

features.name: Profile match + score
features.detail: AND of all specified hard constraints (type, price JPY/USD-converted, prefecture, region, land/building area, bedrooms, build_year, seismic, akiya_bank); unspecified = no constraint. NULL-price akiya are not dropped. Returns (is_match, score 0..1).

features.name: Match-on-ingest + re-match
features.detail: match_for_listings scores touched listings against all active profiles (INSERT OR IGNORE into matches). rematch_profile clears + re-scores one profile against all active listings on create/edit.

features.name: Municipality geocoder
features.detail: OSM Nominatim, max ~1 req/sec, cached in geocache (265 rows) keyed by pref+municipality. Deterministic ~+/-1.5km jitter spreads co-located pins. 1,171 listings carry lat/lng.

features.name: Japan choropleth map
features.detail: folium map: 47-prefecture GeoJson choropleth colored by listing count, focus-corridor styling, Esri/CartoDB/GSI base layers, 4 MLIT hazard overlays, clustered price/photo pins, legend. cities_for() lists municipalities present per prefecture.

features.name: Detail enrichment pass
features.detail: geocode_only() is the fast lat/lng pass (no detail fetch). enrich() fetches at-home detail pages for listings missing photos/specs, adding photo gallery, spec table, listed_date, station, and a translated description; 1s polite delay.

features.name: Profile CRUD
features.detail: criteria_json stored as JSON; creating/editing auto-rematches. Creating a profile auto-inserts a schedules row. set_cadence upserts daily/weekly/monthly/custom_cron.

features.name: Digest builder + email
features.detail: build_digest bundles new (notified=0) matches per profile into an on-site notification, marks matches notified, stamps schedule last_run. build_daily_digest covers 24h new houses. SMTP email gated by email_enabled setting + SMTP_PASSWORD env.

features.name: Background scheduler
features.detail: APScheduler BackgroundScheduler (Asia/Tokyo). Interval ingest job (ingest_interval_hours, default 12) + enrich, daily 08:00 digest, and one CronTrigger digest job per enabled profile schedule. POC-grade — no Redis/Celery.

features.name: DB layer + schema
features.detail: WAL, foreign_keys ON, busy_timeout. init_db applies schema.sql, additive ALTERs (specs_json/listed_date/station_ja), seeds 47 prefectures + 7 sources + default settings. data/akiyascout.db.

features.name: Reference & inventory tables
features.detail: prefectures(47), sources(7), raw_listings(1,915), listings(1,865, 4 indexes), translations(187), profiles(3), matches(203), schedules(3), notifications(3), geocache(265), settings(11).

features.name: Read/search queries
features.detail: Dynamic WHERE builder over all filter keys, JOINs prefectures + sources, adds computed price_usd, cheapest-first ordering. stats() powers /stats and the first-run seed check.

features.name: Six-tab UI
features.detail: gr.Blocks with Map / Discover / Profiles / Matches / Notifications / Settings tabs. Dark slate palette (single PAL source of truth), Inter font. EN / 日本語 / Both language toggle on listings.

features.name: Safe handler wrapper + logging
features.detail: Wraps single-HTML-output handlers to log tracebacks to data/logs/ui.log and render the error in-page instead of a bare toast — so a failing handler is debuggable, not silent.
